clips.title: 纽约市长：市民渴望新政治 聚焦工薪阶层

subtitles.en: I'll be speaking with Congressman Jeffries later today, and I'm looking forward to working with Congressman Jeffries on delivering for the people of our city.
subtitles.zh: 我今天晚些时候将与杰弗里斯议员交谈，期待与他合作，为纽约市民服务。

subtitles.en: And what I see these results as a reflection of are the fact that New Yorkers are hungry for a new kind of politics.
subtitles.zh: 我认为这些结果反映了纽约人渴望一种新的政治。

subtitles.en: They are hungry for a politics that understands working people should be at the heart of it.
subtitles.zh: 他们渴望一种以劳动者为核心的政治。
en_highlights: working people should be at the heart

subtitles.en: And they're hungry for a politics that looks at the wealthiest city in the wealthiest country in the history of the world and understands that it's unacceptable that one in four
subtitles.zh: 他们渴望一种政治，能正视这个世界历史上最富裕国家中最富裕的城市，却仍有四分之一的人生活在贫困中，这是不可接受的。

subtitles.en: are living in poverty. It's unacceptable that too many New Yorkers are spending all of their day trying to figure out how they're going to make their rent check or pay for their groceries or pay their
subtitles.zh: 太多纽约人整天为房租、食品杂货或水电费发愁，这是不可接受的。

subtitles.en: con-ed bill. And what we saw last night was a hunger for leaders who will be there on the front lines looking to make it easier for working people to afford life in the greatest city in
subtitles.zh: 昨晚我们看到的是对领导人的渴望，他们能站在第一线，让劳动者在这个最伟大的城市生活得更轻松。

subtitles.en: the world. We have three potential DSA-aligned members of Congress.
subtitles.zh: 我们有三位可能加入民主社会主义者联盟的国会成员。

subtitles.en: What do you think we should expect from those members? Is it single-payer funded healthcare?
subtitles.zh: 您认为我们应该对他们有何期待？是单一支付方医疗体系吗？

subtitles.en: Is it abolishing borders? Or do you think they should be singularly focused on cutting off a military aid to Israel?
subtitles.zh: 是废除边境？还是他们应专注于切断对以色列的军事援助？
